answer: Force sybil work to be serial. Each identity gets one thread: a fable told in installments, released an hour apart, each part ending with an onyx seal whose description must be carried, changed, into the next part. One agent can follow one unfolding story. A farm running fifty identities must track fifty live threads at once; its scripts reuse phrasing and drop the seal, and readers spot the broken continuity at a glance. Parallelism is the farm's advantage — make it pay in attention, not stake.
